h1: Custom Reflective Bags for Safety and Visibility
metaDescription: Order custom reflective bags for enhanced visibility and safety. Perfect for events, teams, and promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom reflective bags combine everyday utility with high-visibility safety, making them ideal for teams working near traffic, evening commuters, or outdoor event attendees. The reflective strips or panels on these bags ensure the wearer is seen in low light, adding a layer of protection without sacrificing style. Whether you need drawstring sacks for a 5K run or backpacks for your crew, the reflective feature turns a standard promotional bag into a practical safety tool. Choose from options like the Reflective Drawstring Tote or the Safety Drawstring Bag to keep your brand visible after dark.
heroAltText: Custom reflective bags with high-visibility strips for safety, including backpacks and drawstring bags
